title: Kenworth TSeries, T904, T908, T909 Custom Built Hi-Tensile Polished Aluminium FUPS Road Train Bull bar #94
description: Kenworth TSeries, T904, T908,T909,T950 Fups compliant polished Road Train hi-tensile 100mm wide uprights 4 post aluminium bull bar. Extended main channel cowcatcher and 4 small upright. 88mm pipe and a full width additional cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are one piece and pass through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights are 100mm wide & 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin behind a removable recessed number plate. Main bumper channel is contoured to match the mudguard. The top bar is a custom made extrusion to mount driving lights. Optional 76mm or 100mm diameter tube is available on request.
